title: Ricotta and peach mash
summary: Soft ricotta folded into mashed ripe peach: creamy, mild and full of protein.
texture: Soft and slightly lumpy, with small pieces of very ripe peach mashed in.
ingredients: 1/2 very ripe peach, peeled (or thawed frozen peach slices)
steps: Peel the peach and remove the pit. Mash with a fork until soft and lumpy.
Serve on a spoon, or let baby dip a soft banana finger in it.
choking: Use only very ripe, soft peach. If it's firm, steam the slices for 3 to 5 minutes first.
Remove all skin, which can be stringy.

allergens.name: Milk
allergens.note: Ricotta is a soft cheese, so introduce dairy (like plain yogurt) first if your baby hasn't had it. Choose pasteurized ricotta.

storage: Best fresh. Leftover peach mash keeps 1 day in the fridge.
tips: Ricotta is naturally lower in salt than most cheeses, which makes it a good baby cheese.
Pear, mango or ripe plum work just as well.
